scope: Build-time transport reuses exact existing Coax layer decoder output and canonical independently rasterized Sans coverage; runtime only uploads Coax-admitted raw bytes. This is the native legacy image-construction profile, not a claim of byte-identical browser resizing.
command: coax/web/tool.sh aethyr/render/tools/native-textures.coax SLUG LEGACY_SPEC_DIR OUT_DIR > OUT_DIR/textures.config
no_texture_profile: LEGACY_SPEC_DIR may be - only when the compiled profile requires neither layers nor Sans.

jpeg_fixture_compatibility.change: Reconstruct fresh JpgState from owned fields and caller-backed src in test helper; decoder arithmetic/API unchanged.

trust: Texture descriptors are reconciled/validated in Coax; decoded bytes are not cryptographically bound into the current shader-package schema. The build retains separate source/payload hashes.
